title: SkillSnapshot — content-addressed pin of a skill's source + deps + config (Blueprint B § 2.9)
description: Single terminal state `created`. Immutable. New snapshot = new row + new combined_sha. combined_sha = sha256(source_sha || dependency_lock_sha || config_sha) per Blueprint B § 2.9 — concatenation order is NORMATIVE. Predicate URI (deferred Phase B+): skill-snapshot/v1.

skill_id.description: Logical skill identifier — stable across snapshots of the same skill.

tenant_id.description: RESERVED multi-tenancy slot (deferral-G, bd_000-projects-k0fj). OPTIONAL + additive per § 7.2; tenant-isolation semantics deferred to a future DR. v1 single-tenant snapshots omit it.
